patches.reason: The jaffle_shop_duckdb requirements.txt pins networkx==3.7. That release needs Python >=3.12, and the python:3.11-slim container runs 3.11, so pip finds no matching version. The command drops that pin and installs networkx 3.6.1, the newest release that still supports Python 3.11. I haven't run it. The other pins may also need a newer Python, but only networkx appeared in the error.

The jafgen usage line is `jafgen [OPTIONS] [years]`, so the number of years is a positional argument and there is no `--years` flag. `jafgen 6` generates 6 years of data. I didn't run it or check the docs, only read the error output.
